hero.titleLead: We don't show you our work.
hero.subtitle: Codeoura builds and operates enterprise software across six industries. Every system on this page runs in production, and every one has a demonstration you can open and use right now — no sign-up, no call booked.

services.title: Five disciplines, one standard
services.subtitle: We accompany a system from its first architectural decision through to its production environment, and take responsibility for every layer in between. Our services are delivered as one integrated engagement, ready to operate and to scale.

work.title: Systems running today
work.subtitle: A selection of the systems we have designed and delivered, operating in production environments with real users, real data and real operational constraints. Each one is accompanied by a demonstration version you can explore yourself.
work.empty: No projects in this category at present.
work.demoNote: A working copy running on illustrative data. No changes are saved, and it contains no customer data.

stack.title: Technologies we adopt and stand behind
stack.subtitle: We select our technologies on the basis of maturity, reliability and long-term support. This is the stack we operate in production, and the one in which we hold the depth of experience required to guarantee stability and scale.

about.title: An engineering studio, not a delivery agency
about.subtitle: We take a system from its first architectural decision through to its production environment, and stay with it after handover. What distinguishes what we build is not how it looks on launch day, but what it costs to extend a year later and how readily a new engineer can read it.
about.processSubtitle: Four clearly defined phases, a working deployment from the first iteration, and regular reporting on progress.

products.title: Seven systems, seven open demonstrations
products.subtitle: From an online storefront to a clinical platform to a delivery marketplace. Open any card to launch its demonstration in a new tab — entirely illustrative data, with nothing you can break.

path.title: Where are you now?
path.subtitle: You do not need all seven. You need the right order for the ones you do. Read the route that matches your situation and begin at its first step.

ecosystem.title: The whole ecosystem in one place
ecosystem.subtitle: Every system has an open door. Pick the one that concerns you and walk in.

outcomes.title: What actually changed
outcomes.subtitle: Extracts from the case studies, attributed to the system that produced them. Not courtesy testimonials — outcomes you can verify by opening the demonstration yourself.

cta.title: Try the systems first, then talk to us
cta.subtitle: Open any demonstration above and use it the way a real customer would. When you have decided, write to us with what you need and we will respond within one business day.
